to be fr. rt. वे), a cane, reed, (probably a corruption

वेतसिनी, f., N. of a river; [cf. वेदसिनी.]

वेतस्-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, reedy, abounding in reeds
or canes (as a place, soil, &c.).
वेतन वेतन, अम्, n. (according to Uṇādi-s.

. fr. rt. 1. वी; perhaps a corrupted form of
वर्तन), hire, wages, stipend, salary; livelihood,
subsistence; silver.
—वेतन-जीविन्, ई, इनी, इ, sub-
sisting by hire or wages, stipendiary.
—वेतन-दान,
अम्, n. the paying of wages, hiring.
—वेतनादान
(˚न-अद्˚), अम्, n. non-payment of wages.

वेतनिन्, ई, इनी, इ, receiving wages, stipendiary,
(sometimes at the end of a comp., e. g. कुप्य-
वेतनिन्, receiving very small pay.)
वेतसु वेतसु, उस्, m., Ved., N. of an Asura.

वेताल वेताल, अस्, m. (according to some
for अव-इत + आल for आलय; according to others
fr. वे, loc. c. of 2. व + ताल), a kind of ghost,
spirit, goblin, vampire, demon (especially one occu-
pying a dead body); a door-keeper, (in this sense pro-
bably for वेत्र + आल.)
—वेताल-पञ्चविंशति, इस्, or
वेताल-पञ्चविंशतिका, f. a collection of twenty-five
tales or fables told by a Vetāla to king Vikramāditya
(of which there are three recensions extant, two by
Śiva-dāsa and one by Jambhala-bhaṭṭa; versions of
these popular tales exist in Hindī and almost every
Hindū vernacular, as well as in Tamil and Telugu,
and translations in other languages are also current).
—वेताल-पञ्चविंशति-कथा, f., N. of part of the
Vṛhat-kathā.

वेत्तृ 1. वेत्तृ, ता, त्री, तृ (fr. rt. 1. विद्), one
who knows, knowing, understanding, acquainted
with; a knower, &c.; one who obtains or acquires,
obtaining; (ता), m. a sage, one who knows the
nature of the soul and god; one who obtains in
marriage, an espouser, husband.
—वेत्तृ-त्व, अम्,
n. knowledge.
वेत्र वेत्र, अस्, m. (according to Uṇādi-s.

. fr. rt. 1. वी; probably rather fr. rt. वे), a
reed, cane, the ratan; (अम्), n. a sort of creeper,
(in this sense apparently also अस्, m.); a stick, staff;
the rod or mace of an officer, staff of a door-keeper.
—वेत्र-धर, अस्, m. a staff-bearer, mace-bearer;
a door-keeper, warder.
—वेत्र-धारक, अस्, m. a
door-keeper, warder, porter; a mace-bearer.
—वेत्र-
पाणि, इस्, m. ‘staff-handed,’ a mace-bearer.
—वेत्र-
यष्टि, इस्, m. f. a staff of reed or cane.
—वेत्र-लता,
f. ‘reed-branch,’ a staff or stick.
—वेत्र-वती, f. ‘full
of reeds,’ the Betwa river (which, rising in the Vindhya
mountains and following a north-easterly direction
for about 340 miles, falls into the Jumnā below
Kalpī); a female door-keeper; a proper N.
—वेत्रा-
घात (˚र-आघ्˚), अस्, m. a blow with a cane, a
caning.
—वेत्रासन (˚र-आस्˚), अम्, n. ‘cane-seat,’
[]
a small cot or oblong low couch of cane work, (when
furnished with bamboo sticks and a pole, it forms
the common dooly or litter.)
—वेत्रासनासीन (˚न-
आस्˚), अस्, आ, अम्, seated on a seat of cane or reed.

वेत्रकीय, अस्, आ, अम्, reedy, abounding with
reeds or canes.

वेत्रिन्, ई, m. a staff-bearer, mace-bearer, porter,
door-keeper.
